preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) for row in G) and all(len(row) == len(G[0]) for row in G) and len(G) > 0
preconditions.description: G is a non-empty rectangular matrix where each row represents an applicant's interest in jobs (1=interested, 0=not interested).

preconditions.expression: all(all(element in {0, 1} for element in row) for row in G)
preconditions.description: Each element in G is either 0 or 1, indicating no interest or interest in a job, respectively.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum(row) for row in G) and return_value >= 0
postconditions.description: The function returns the maximum number of applicants that can be assigned to distinct jobs they are interested in, where no job is assigned to more than one applicant.
The returned value is a non-negative integer not exceeding the smaller of the number of applicants (M) or jobs (N).
